tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bskang ba'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bskang ba'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// don dam bden par chos rnams ngo bos stong*// gzod nas bskang bya skong byed med mod kyang*// kun rdzob blo ngor mchod bskang bshags bstod sogs// rten cing 'brel 'byung ltar snang tsam 'di lta// sgrub pa po gang zhig rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bgyi bar spro ba/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i nang du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma'i mtha' skor du/ spyan gzigs 'dod yon sna tshogs pa 'bur ram bris pas bskor/ dar gyi rgyal mtshan dang dkar dmar gyi rgyan/ sman raka mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ bskang ba'i rdzas rnams kyi dngos 'dzin rnam rtog 'bag btsog nyes skyon dri ma thams cad bsregs sbyangs gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas mchog /rang rang gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i 'dod yon kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ sarba bid+yā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin brlabs/ sbyar dang rang byung gi spos sreg /dar gyi g.yab mo bya/ rol mo brjid dang ldan pa du ma'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ phyogs bcu dus gsum kun tu gshegs pa dang*// bzhugs dang 'byon 'gyur rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// yi dam zhi khro dam can srung mar bcas// ma sring mkha' 'gro sde brgyad yul gyi lha// gzhi bdag tshogs bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ */ stong gsum dang mnyam gdan yangs par// rtsa gsum sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*// dam can dregs pa yul lha dang*// gzhi bdag tshogs bcas dgyes bzhin bzhugs// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

hūm̐ */ dad pas mchod phyir spyan drangs pa'i// mgron la bdag cag mos pa'i blos// mnyam pa nyid du phyag bgyid cing*// dga' zhing spro bas 'dud par bgyi// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ hūm̐ */ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin// nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs 'di rnams// mgron gyi tshogs la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod| |oṃ pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las mi zad rlabs po che// ngo mtshar rmad byung mthong ba la// bdag yid dang bas bstod par bgyi// zhes brjod/ bskang ba'i cho ga dngos ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// 'dod yon longs spyod rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// 'tsho ngom yid 'ong sla zhing ro mi gsal// dwangs shing nyi zla rlung gi reg pa yi// yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mchod yon dang*// chu gtsang sman gyis sbags pa'i zhabs bsil dang*// dri bsung kha dog rnam bkra'i me tog tshogs// sbyar dang rang byung bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs// nyi zla lta bu'i snang gsal 'od du 'bar// dri bzang sna tshogs ngad ldan byug pa dang*// ro brgya ldan pa lha yi zhal zas brjid// rol mo snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs drug skyes glu// gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim ro bda' zhing*// reg 'jam spros bral chos dbyings dag pa dang*// 'khor lo rin chen dpal be'u bum pa nya// pad+ma gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bkra shis brgyad// nor bu 'khor lo btsun mo blon po bzang*// so ldan cang shes dmag dpon rin chen bdun// khyim dang stan sogs nye ba'i rin chen tshogs// sna tshogs nor bu gos dang sman dang 'bru// mkho dgu'i longs spyod ma tshang med pa yis// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang shes rab bzang*// ye shes dngos grub chos kyi blo gros zhabs// rdo rje rgyal mtshan zla 'od gzhon nu dang*// rdo rje rgyal po rat+na shrī la sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad dang*// phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*// drang nges dam chos mchog tshogs 'dus par bcas// 'dren mchog 'dus pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// skong gyur dbang dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */

yid 'ong chu gtsang sman ldan pa// rdo rje'i mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// 'thor 'thung zhabs bsil bcas pa'i tshogs// me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// bdud rtsi lnga dang lcags kyu lnga// bde chen lha mo'i snyoms 'jug dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa yis// bcom ldan khrag 'thung 'khor lo sdom// yum chen rdo rje phag mor bcas// mkha' 'gro mdzes ma dum skyes ma// gzugs can mar bcas thugs dam bskang*| |dgyes mdzad zhe sdang rdo rje dang*// mā yā gdan bzhi thod par bcas// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa// rgyud rgyal lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// phyi nang gsang mchod de bzhin nyid// rtsa ra mdangs dang srog chags rgyu// mchod pa phud dang gling bzhi mdos// sman raka gtor tshogs rgya mtsho yis// bde gshegs zhi ba che mchog dang*| |yang dag gshin rje rta mgrin dbang*// phur pa rbod gtong bla mar bcas// dregs pa drag sngags bka' sdod tshogs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo g.yar dam skong*// rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// bud+dha mi bskyod pad+ma dbang*// rig 'dzin me phreng thod pa dang*// rta mgrin gsang bdag yab yum 'khor// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs| |zhe brgyad sgo ba mtshams mar bcas// bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi// lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe yi bdag /yum sras 'chi bdag srog bdag dang*// bka' nyan gshin rje ma mo sogs// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// shing thog sna tshogs dkar mngar gyis// drang srong dri med thugs dam bskang*| |rang rang mthun pa'i longs spyod kyis// 'khor gyi sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// gu ru drag po rtsal la sogs// yi dam rgyal ba zhi dang khro/ /dam pa rigs brgya la sogs pa| |thugs dam bskang ngo dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen dang*// pad+ma las kyi dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang bcas pa// ma sring rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*| |skong gyur rkyen ngan bar gcod sol// hūm̐ */

ma rungs gdug tshogs 'dul ba'i phyir// khrag 'thung dpyid kyi rgyal mo yi// dgyes pa'i gad mo bcu gnyis kyis// lha mo u ma la rol ba'i// sras mchog rdo rje srin po che// bka' sdod las kyi mgon po ni// tshe bdag 'chi bdag srog gi bdag /gnod sbyin bya rog gdong pa can// sha za nag po 'phrog byed gdong*| |yum chen lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /thugs yum dmar mo rtsa 'jib ma// lha mo dus mtshan re ma ti// bya rgod khyung dang khwa ta dang*// 'ug pa phag dang khyi spyang dang*/ stag gdong mkha' 'gro chen mo brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri// yang sprul bya dang gcan gzan tshogs// ro langs gnod sbyin sha za dang*// pho bdud mo bdud dregs pa'i tshogs// 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba ni// phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// cang shes nag po rlung ltar 'phyo// g.yag nag zhol chen sprin ltar mthug /khyi nag thugs dkar khro zhing gtum// bhe ta nag po rab tu 'gying*// 'khor lo dar sna'i rgyan gyis spras// phrag par nyams pa'i liṅgar bcas| |gser skyems phud kyi bran pa yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bya rog rgyal mtshan rgyan dang ldan// kha na dgra bgegs liṅga 'phyang*| |lcags phur 'khor lo me long bcas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dpa' bo gri rgod snying chen por// srog gi tsakra sngags dang bcas| |sman 'bru 'dod yon du ma'i tshogs// tshul bzhin chas su bcug pa yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// nag po bzhi yi rgyal mtshan la// dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar ba dang*// mda' rgod bzhi la snying chen bzhi// gser gyis bris pa'i sngags ring dang*// sku gzugs tshad dang ldan pa la// rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bkod pa dang*// mda' nag bzhi la dar nag bzhi// brten pa'i byang bu brgyad dang bcas// gri rgod gsang ba'i rmugs chen dang*/

dar nag mtshal gyi srog 'khor la// rtsa sngags gsum gyis rab gnas pa// dar tshon sna lngas dril ba dang*// ce spyang dar ma'i snying nang du// bsad pa'i sngags dang dgra gzugs bcas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// bla rdo'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rta nag khyi nag bud med ni// mtshan ldan rmu lugs kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rgya mtsho gangs kyi rdo nag dang*// dūrba yungs kar sngags dang bcas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*| |sku yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bya rog g.yang gzhi nag po'i sku// gsang ba'i dam rdzas gyis bris pa'i// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir| |sa zla dngul gyis legs bris pa'i// snying po nye snying bris pa yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs kyi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// ka wu wa pa rta nag snying*// rin chen lnga dang bcas pa yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// yon tan rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// rak+sha gri thod mā lā yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// phrin las rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// mi bsad lcags kyi gri gug la// hūm̐ nag 'bar bas mdzes pa yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// mchod bskul rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// snying gi rnam pa thams cad dang*// nya sha 'bru chen sman sna dang*// bsnyen pa'i ba liṃ brjid ldan dang*// rdzas dang rtags gtor gur nag dbub// sha lnga sman lnga myos byed bcas| |nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// 'bod pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gri lag dar nag sngags bris pas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// bzhugs pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dur khrod 'bar ba'i khang bzang gis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// phyag mtshan rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// breng zhags gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ gas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// mchod pa'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir// khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dug puṣ+pe// sha chen spos dang zhun chen me/

/mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zas/ /mi rkang thod rnga drag po'i sgras| |nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i phyir// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi yis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// ba liṃ zas su bza' ba'i phyir// 'bru nag dpal bshos brjid ldan gyis// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i ru dhī ras// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*| |sku yi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// dus bzhir bza' btung phud gtsang mas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsung gi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// bzlas brjod dzāpa bsnyen mi g.yel bas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// ting 'dzin mi g.yo rtse gcig pas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// yon tan thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// dar nag rak+ta bhan+dhar bcas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// phrin las thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// bsnyen sgrub srung zlog 'bod rbad bsad| |sreg mnan zor rdzas sna tshogs pas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// go khrab phub dang mda' gzhu mdung*// ral gri tri shūl shak+ti dang*// gos zhwa spyan gzigs sna tshogs pas// nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// skong gyur phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod// hrīḥ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yang sprul pa// bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgron// sha za ye shes dam tshig dbang*// thugs sprul za byed gsod byed dang*// 'phrog byed khro mo dmar mo dang*// srog gi spu gri snying bsgul ma// sha za dmar nag stong dang bcas// srog gi bshan pa 'bum phrag dang*// mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs bcas rnams// bskang ngo gsol lo mchod par bgyi// mdzes pa'i khang bzang rin chen rgyan// dar zab bla bre yol ba dang*| |lda ldi rat+na'i pho long 'phyangs// sna tshogs dkor nor spyan gzigs bkram// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// yid 'ong rgyun bzang ar+ghaṃ dang*// sman spos chu gtsang zhabs bsil dang*// mtshar sdug me tog lang tsho bkra// dri bzang spos kyi bdug pa dkrigs// snang gsal sgron me 'od du 'bar// dri chab ngad ldan mtsho ltar bskyil// ro brgya ldan pa lha'i zhal zas// lnga ldan sgra snyan rol mor bcas// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// mig la dga' skyed gzugs kyi mchog

/rna ba'i bdud rtsi glu dang dbyangs// shangs la bsung ba'i dri sna tshogs// ljags la bda' ba'i bza' ba dang*// srab 'jam yang ba'i reg bya dang*// sna tshogs 'dod 'byung chos kyis ni// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// rgyal po'i srid la 'os pa yi// rin chen sna bdun bkra shis brgyad// spyad byar 'os pa'i longs spyod kun// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ra sa yā na btung ba'i mchog /dmar chen rgya mtsho che ltar bskyil// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor mar bcas// chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// g.yab dar sngon po bya rgod mda'// 'bod pa'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// dkor mdzod dgyes dgu'i nor dang bcas// bzhugs pa'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// 'bri sngon rta dkar shel sgong lug /'brong chen rgya bong mkha' lding sogs// phyi yi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// khrung khrung mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan la// dar zab sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// nang gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// sa le sbram dang pī rā dza// sna tshogs 'bru dang le brgan dar// gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// sba lcag srog 'khor phyag rgyar bcas// sku yi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// dzāpa dang bstod dbyangs drug skyes mchog /gsung gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// dri med rab dwangs dngul dkar gyi// me long rgyang gsal 'od 'bar ba// thugs kyi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// bzang po drug dang sman sna tshogs| |dar zab ma tshang med pa ste// yon tan rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// sil snyan rnga dung 'khar rnga dang*// ḍā ma ru dang dril bu sogs/ /phrin las rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// rten gtor bta' gtor rtags gtor dang*// rgyun gtor 'phral gtor la sogs pa// brten pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs dang*// gos dang rgyan bzang bzhon pa dang*// khyim dang mkho dgu'i nor dbyig gis// chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dngos grub stsol// kyai/

gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni// bka' brgyud rin chen srung ma ste// rigs ni a dzi dha ra'i rgyud// mi min 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshul// don gyi ye shes ḍā ki ma// lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dgyes pa bskyed phyir mchod pa'i sprin// bza' bca' btung ba gyon pa dang*// sman 'bru rin chen gser skyems phud// ri dwags g.yung dwags sman raka gtor// 'dod yon tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// bai/ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po ni// ngal bsos dge ba'i sras btsun mo// rta bdag brgyad dang sde dpon tshogs// phyi nang blon 'bangs dpag yas rnams// dgyes phyir ri gling 'khor yug khyon// gos sngon lung thang phreng ba rta// 'dod 'jo gter bum dpag bsam shing*// bris sku rgyal srid bdun dang rtags// rdzas brgyad lnga tshan lnga sogs dang*// lha klu mi yi dbyig sna tshogs// mkho dgu ma tshang med pa'i dngos// gtor mchod ting 'dzin zab mo yis// rgyal chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dbul sel nam mdzod dngos grub rtsol// hūm̐ */ sman dang rak+ta gtor ma dang*// sha rus dbang po lnga dag dang*// sbyor dang sgrol ba'i longs spyod kyis| |dpal ldan sngags srung ra gdong ma// gza' mchog chen po rā hu la// skyes bu dam can thig le rtsal// ha ra mi zan srog gi gshed// gter bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas bskang*| |hūm̐ */ bdud rta nag po rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo// g.yag nag ru rnon rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'gying*// khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar gtum zhing rngam// lug nag rgyan ldan mun ltar rab tu brjid// btsos pa'i sha dang bsregs pa'i gsur chen po// khu ba khrag dang lha ba zhag rkang mar// rus pa dbang po rnam lnga nang khrol bcas// dmar chen gtor ma rgyan ldan sman rak+ta// dom nag snying dang srog 'khor ting 'dzin sngags// dar nag gos zhwa mtshon rnon go char bcas// lha chen kun dga' gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang*// mchog chen mchog phran sna tshogs sha yi ri// dmar chen ar+ghaṃ btung ba ma da na// mthun pa'i rdzas mchog ma tshang med pa yis// yum chen si na ra ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ra yi dbang po rnam lnga phyugs chen sha// mi yi khrag zhag bshos bu dkar dmar dang*// myos byed bza' btung rang rang mthun rdzas kyis// las mkhan pho mo sde brgyad dang bcas pa// bdud kyi dmag tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ */

yang gcig thugs dam bskang ba ni// yab ni srin po dz+wa la 'bar// yum ni klu mo glog 'gyu ma// sras mchog drang srong rā hu la// lus brgyad dum brgyad gza' chen brgyad// stag srin bam srin kong srin dang*// 'brog srin lha dang gshin rje klu// gnod sbyin rgyal po btsan dang rmu// bdud dang res gza' rgyu skar bcas| |bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam bskang*// gza' bdud pha yis gnang ba'i zas// sha rul khrag rul nya rul dang*// btsos dang rjen sha sna tshogs pas// gza' mchog chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// gza' bdud ma yis gnang ba'i zas// la sman rtsi sman sna tshogs dang*// bu ram sbrang rtsi ka ra dang*// 'o ma mar dang zhor bcas pa'i// drang srong chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// sngags 'chang bdag gis stob pa'i zas// zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang bgegs// pho nyas bkug cing lha dang phral// rbod gtong phur thun mtshon cha yis// bsgral ba'i snying sogs nang khrol tshogs// sha khrag pags rus klad par bcas// khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// ljang sngon drag po'i thugs dam bskang*// biṣ+ṇu rā dza'i thugs dam bskang*| |drang srong dkar po'i thugs dam bskang*// bdud po rok+ti'i thugs dam bskang*// du ba mjug ring thugs dam bskang*// bi tri pa tra'i thugs dam bskang*// sgra gcan zin gyi thugs dam bskang*// stag dom ba lang nya snying gis// gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyis// lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*// spyan gzigs 'dod yon dkor nor gyis// gza' skar tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// kye/ bskang ngo gsol lo mchod pa ni// thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin che// sku yi rgyal po mon bu ste// yon tan rgyal po shing bya can// gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes// phrin las rgyal po pe dkar che// sprul pa lnga dang yum chen lnga// blon po lnga dang gnam gyi yab// gnod sbyin thog 'bebs lha'i dge bsnyen// mgon po thang nag bha tra dang*// pu tra srog bdag dmag dpon che// rgyal mtshan bdun bdag ru 'dren tshogs// spu gri mched lnga stong dpon bdun// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni// rta dkar phrum dmar sprin ltar 'phyo// spre'u dkar ngo dmar glog ltar 'khyugs// bya dkar ze dmar gnam du 'tsher// 'bag seng gar mkhan rtse zhing rol// lha khang lder bzo byis pa sogs// rā dza'i cho 'phrul ya ma zung*// dkor mdzod nor dang sba dkar smyug
